cols={'1':np.ones_like(x),'x':x,'x2':x*x,'x3':x**3,'v':v,'v2':v*v,'v3':v**3,'1/v':1/v,'x/v':x/v,'x2/v':x*x/v,'x3/v':x**3/v,'xv':x*v,'x2v':x*x*v,'x3v':x**3*v,'xv2':x*v*v,'x2v2':x*x*v*v,'v2/x':v*v/x,'1/x':1/x}
names=list(cols); M=np.column_stack([cols[k] for k in names])
def run(sub):
    A=M[:,[names.index(s) for s in sub]]
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]; r=dv_dt-A@c
